name: ts-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins collection by Thibault SAVENKOFF.

plugins.name: git-sync
plugins.description: Carries work in progress between machines as a checkpoint branch, without WIP commits in your history.

plugins.name: claude-model-advisor
plugins.description: Automatically recommends the optimal Claude model (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, Opus 5) and reasoning effort level (Low to Ultracode).

plugins.name: jev-guard
plugins.description: Flags plaintext secrets in the files Claude writes and can hold back a git-sync checkpoint that carries one. Bring your own TypeSafe API key.
